clue.text: Opposed being retired — it's not stimulating

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the word for opposed is read backwards

parts.note: to have faced someone is to have opposed them

explanation.surface: Someone who stood against the motion has stepped down, a dull sort of affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being retired' turns FACED back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Decaffeinated coffee has had its caffeine removed, so it gives no stimulant kick.

clue.text: Garden plot over time becoming liability

parts.note: a bed is a plot in a garden

explanation.surface: A garden plot becomes a burden over time.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt is money owed, a financial liability.

clue.text: Get across India on tractor possessed by collective group

clue.text: Weak fellow obsequiously servile with head down

explanation.definitionFit: Flimsy means insubstantial or feeble, as with a weak argument or structure.

clue.text: Woozy feeling I would enjoy going round head

indicators.note: turning round means the words for 'I would' and 'enjoy' are read backwards

a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness's neighbour Dungeness

explanation.surface: A dizzy spell that someone claims they'd relish spinning their head about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' reads as a body part, but here it means a headland, the sense found in place names along the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Giddiness is a dizzy, light-headed sensation, the state of being woozy.

clue.text: Partially hidden, going round selling weed

indicators.note: partly concealed within the phrase, so the answer lies inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A furtive dealer circulates while selling marijuana.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common yellow-flowered plant regarded as a garden weed.

clue.text: Food outlet outside hospital in Asian city

clue.text: Name of many queens is a title used cyclically

explanation.walkthrough: 'used cyclically' moves L and A from the front of LABEL to the back, giving BELLA.

clue.text: Minor unopened letter

clue.text: Graduate doctor in first of operations is young one

the letters of act are pulled out of the mix in no particular order

explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters A, C, T out of ANTISOCIAL and rearrange the seven that remain.

clue.text: Down-to-earth broadcast probing replacement for school of thought

clue.text: A figure backing alliance
